title: What Survival Benchmarks Don't Tell You: Impact of Model Selection and Dataset Regimes
abstract: arXiv:2611.24837v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite the proliferation of survival analysis methods, current benchmarks often operate under narrow conditions: they heavily rely on the concordance index (C-index) for evaluation and model selection, and frequently either exclude deep learning (DL) methods or underrepresent challenging dataset regimes. To address these limitations, we conduct a large-scale, neutral benchmark comparing 10 classical, tree-based, and DL methods across 49 diverse datasets. Crucially, we treat the model selection criterion (optimizing for C-index, Integrated Brier Score (IBS), or Mean Absolute Error (MAE-PO)) as an independent experimental variable. Using Bayesian mixed-effects modeling, we demonstrate that evaluation design heavily dictates conclusions. For complex DL and tree-based architectures, selecting hyperparameters to optimize for IBS instead of C-index yields substantial improvements in probabilistic accuracy and calibration at a negligible cost

translated_title: 生存分析基准测试无法告诉你的事：模型选择与数据集条件的影响
translated_abstract: 尽管生存分析方法层出不穷，但当前的基准测试往往在狭窄的条件下进行：它们严重依赖一致性指数（C-index）进行评估和模型选择，并且经常排除深度学习（DL）方法或未能充分代表具有挑战性的数据集条件。为了解决这些局限性，我们开展了一项大规模、中立的大规模基准测试，在49个多样化数据集上比较了10种经典方法、基于树的方法和深度学习方法。至关重要的是，我们将模型选择标准（分别针对C-index、综合Brier分数（IBS）或平均绝对误差（MAE-PO）进行优化）视为一个独立的实验变量。通过贝叶斯混合效应建模，我们证明了评估设计在很大程度上决定了研究结论。对于复杂的深度学习和基于树的架构，选择超参数时以IBS而非C-index为优化目标，能以几乎可以忽略不计的代价，显著提升概率预测的准确性和校准度。
tldr: 该研究通过涵盖10种方法与49个数据集的大规模中立基准测试，揭示了评估设计对结论的决定性影响，并发现对深度学习和树模型而言，以IBS而非C-index为目标进行超参数优化，能以极低成本大幅提升概率预测的准确性与校准度。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale neutral benchmark of 10 methods across 49 datasets, this study shows that evaluation design heavily dictates conclusions—optimizing hyperparameters for IBS instead of C-index yields substantial improvements in probabilistic accuracy and calibration for complex DL and tree-based architectures at negligible cost.
